metadata.description: Personal skills for implementation planning, DevOps pipeline planning, task ticket generation, end-to-end GitHub ticket handling (implement, review, and fix), and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

plugins.name: impl-plan
plugins.description: Create and maintain implementation plan documents in docs/plans/

plugins.name: devops-plan
plugins.description: Generate DevOps pipeline plans as markdown documents in .github/workflows/

plugins.name: task-tickets
plugins.description: Generate and register task tickets from implementation plans to a kanban tool (GitHub Projects, Linear, Notion, Jira)

plugins.name: handle-ticket
plugins.description: Handle a GitHub project ticket end-to-end: implement it with per-sub-item commits and live status tracking, open a PR, self-review it with the official code-review skill, post findings as inline comments, fix them, and reply to each comment

plugins.name: eval-pipeline-plan
plugins.description: Generate evaluation pipeline plans for GenAI agents and skills, with LangSmith tracking and Azure ML deployment

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Research and write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in docs/adrs/
